read.title: Feedback on Holiday Campaign Visuals
read.text:
Hi Chloe,

Thank you for the first draft of the holiday campaign visuals. The layout looks great, and the team loves the snow theme.

However, the colors feel a bit too dark for our brand's tone and manner. Could you take another pass at the key visual using lighter pink tones? We'd also like the product to be larger in the Instagram version.

This will be our first round of revisions. What's the turnaround time for these changes? We need the final deliverables by December 1st.

Best,
Minsu

Hi Ryan,

Thanks for the video draft. The music and pacing are excellent. Could you take another pass at the captions and make them shorter? Viewers often watch without sound, so short text works better. What's the turnaround time for this revision?

Best,
Minsu
